svg.text: F21-10 Points list review counts: CRAH 11 (40 points) and CDU 07 (30 points)
B2-DH3-CRAH-11 BACnet/IP, device 232011 · B2-DH3-CDU-07 Modbus TCP mapped to BACnet, device 233007 · counts by object type, alarm class and trend method, taken
• CRAH 11 has 40 points: 17 AI, 2 AO, 5 AV, 11 BI, 3 BV, 1 MSV and 1 CharacterString; 22 carry an alarm class and 18 have none.
• CDU 07 has 30 points: 17 AI, 2 AV, 8 BI, 1 BO and 2 MSI; 12 points are trended at 10 s for the CDU tests and 21 carry an alarm class.
